name: Iizumi Hiroto
source:
Although he is notoriously troublesome, he is THE average person with three perfect qualities: normal appearance, normal grades, and normal athletic ability. His hobbies include surfing the Internet and playing bishojo games.

Although he longs for a life of fulfillment, he ends up wasting his days in idleness due to his lazy and tedious nature. He and his classmate, Ami Himekawa, have had a close relationship since junior high school and is one of the few girls with whom he can casually converse.

His latest problem is whether or not to use Ami as jerk off material for the night. It is a difficult question that crosses the line.

Nanase seduced him into founding the “Intellectual and Cultural Studies Club,” and forced him to become the head of the club, which he continues to do.

Although he considers himself normal, he has a strong desire for trouble, and his tastes are quite broad, making him a pervert in that area. He is not aware of it at all, perhaps because he has an extreme friend, Yoshio, nearby.

[From [url=http://rootnuko.jp/products/tenioha/character.html]official site[/url]]
